Subject: Pricing benchmark + recommended target $/1M (draft)

Alyssa —

Thanks for the volume and budget bands — that made the modeling straightforward. Below is a concise benchmark for ZenHealth’s likely case (360M tokens/mo). I’m attaching the exported tab from our unit econ sheet for transparency.

Quick high-level:
- Redwood Hosted API (no commit) — recommended operational model for quick start. Modeled effective $/1M (observed with 15% KV cache, moderate batching): ~$42 / 1M tokens. Monthly bill (360M): ~$15,120. Latency: p95 ~180–260ms depending on model and region.
- Redwood Dedicated (12mo commit, 70% utilization assumed) — effective $/1M (fully loaded amortized infra + SW) : ~$18 / 1M tokens. Effective monthly cost (360M): ~$6,480 (plus base infra reservation fee broken out). Latency: p95 ~120–200ms with reserved capacity.
- OpenAI (public hosted pricing reference, modeled): ~$62 / 1M tokens (360M -> ~$22,320). Latency: p95 ~150–220ms depending on plan.
- Anthropic (modeled hosted): ~$55 / 1M tokens (360M -> ~$19,800). Latency: p95 ~160–240ms.
- Other managed hosts (representative snapshot across smaller hosts / HF infra): a wide range; median observed ~36–70 / 1M depending on model quantization and batching.

Recommended target for procurement scorecard: two rows — a) Hosted target: $35 / 1M (aggressive but achievable with caching & batching); b) Dedicated target: $20 / 1M (12mo commit, performance SLA). Rationale: Hosted target gives them headroom vs OpenAI; Dedicated target materially undercuts public-hosted incumbents if they can commit to a 12-month reservation and hit ~70% utilization.

Next steps:
1) If useful, we can model ZenHealth’s exact 3-point volume scenarios in the attached spreadsheet (sends detailed breakouts for low/likely/high).
2) If procurement wants the Dedicated example, we’ll need a rough utilization confirmation and signature on a short commercial term sheet (non-binding) to price reservable instances precisely.
3) Propose a 30-min call Wed (12–2pm PT) to walk procurement through the numbers and the tradeoffs between Hosted vs Dedicated.

If you’re happy with the two recommended targets ($35 hosted / $20 dedicated per 1M), we’ll mark those in the vendor comparison doc and send a clean 1-pager for the procurement scorecard.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
